hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -E "rm -rf /|git push --force|git reset --hard" >/dev/null; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command' && exit 2; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -E "\.env|report\.tex|slides/" >/dev/null; then echo 'WARNING: sensitive path, require explicit approval'; fi
for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$f" in *.py) python -m ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; done
for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if echo "$f" | grep -q "assignments-hard/.*/tests/"; then python -m pytest "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done
